Sparks Group Ride

Sparks, NV · Road

Beginner friendly

Sparks Group Ride is a road group ride in Sparks, NV. It rolls every Saturday at 10:00 am from Sierra Bicycle Supply. Pace: friendly, social, recreational; all experience levels.

About the Sparks Group Ride group ride

A friendly, social Saturday ride from a Sparks bike shop, open to all experience levels. Moved to Sierra Bicycle Supply in June 2026 so riders can grab supplies before rolling. Listed on the Reno Wheelmen calendar with weekly ride updates.
